summary: The registrant, Metals Royalty Co Inc., filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about an update on Mesabi Metallics’ construction progress following an executive site visit. The filing is a routine status report on a third-party project; it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural changes to the registrant are disclosed. The filing is purely informational and operational in nature, with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
